description.zh: 指定List操作需要从此token开始。您可以从返回结果中的NextContinuationToken获取此token。
description.en: The token from which the List operation must start. You can obtain this token from NextContinuationToken in the response.

description.zh:
指定返回对象FC接入点的最大数量。

取值：大于0小于等于1000。

> 如果因为max-keys的设置无法一次完成列举，返回结果会附加一个`<NextContinuationToken>`作为下一次列举的continuation-token。
description.en:
The maximum number of Object FC Access Points to return.

Valid values: greater than 0 and less than or equal to 1000.

> If the results cannot be completely listed at a time due to the max-keys setting, the response includes a `<NextContinuationToken>` element as the continuation-token for the next listing operation.

descriptions.zh: 阿里云账号默认拥有获取对象FC接入点信息的权限。如果您希望通过RAM用户或者STS的方式获取对象FC接入点信息，您必须拥有`oss:ListAccessPointsForObjectProcess`权限。
descriptions.en: An Alibaba Cloud account has the permission to retrieve Object FC Access Point information by default. To retrieve Object FC Access Point information by using a Resource Access Management (RAM) user or Security Token Service (STS), you must have the `oss:ListAccessPointsForObjectProcess` permission.
